releases.title: Control Data Governance access per user
changes: Data Governance starts enabled only for the exact username mani. Other users and administrators start disabled.
Administrators can grant or revoke Data Governance under Users & passwords > Feature access, with their password and a saved-version check.
Enforce per-user access on governance reads, edits, exports, OCI publication and automation. Recheck access before releasing responses or publishing policies.
Keep roles, dataset assignments, approved privacy protections and legal holds independent of module access. Existing sessions refresh feature visibility.

releases.title: Operate your data governance policies
changes: Run saved-data quality checks and pattern-based sensitivity discovery, with field rules, review/freshness alerts and source-change detection.
Propose privacy, quality, scheduling and retention controls for approval by a different administrator. Approved masking protects ordinary-user results and blocks raw source and grounded-chat access.
Place immediate legal holds, release them independently, and manage holds on retired datasets. Holds block deletion, retention and workspace reset.
Schedule approved quality scans and OCI metadata publication on the existing runtime. Apply approved inactivity retention through recoverable retirement and a purge grace period.
Inspect content-free access audit events with journal integrity checks. Purges retain policy/audit proof and exclude provider backups, external exports and noncurrent object versions.

Optionally verify an OCI Custom Lineage Provider before submitting saved OpenLineage events. Native provider creation is still rejected in the current Mumbai catalog; Aegis lineage and export remain available.

releases.title: Govern your dataset metadata
changes: Open Data Governance from the Dashboard to inspect authorized datasets, accountable owners, stewards and sensitivity classifications.
Save business purpose, descriptive retention guidance and dataset glossary definitions with version checks and change history.
Inspect ownership and classification in Metadata Relationships; export complete scoped metadata and saved OpenLineage without original text or extracted values.
Administrators can verify an existing OCI Data Catalog and explicitly publish policy descriptions, metadata counts and glossary terms using server-side credentials.
Native OCI lineage ingestion remains disabled; lineage is available in Aegis and its export. Existing grants enforce access, and retention guidance does not delete files.

releases.title: Explore metadata relationships
changes: Open Metadata Relationships from the Dashboard Knowledge Source header, on demand.
Explore access-scoped datasets, documents, saved extraction runs, prompt versions, review revisions and mapped models.
Inspect records and relationships with dataset selection, search, graph/list views, zoom, pan and mobile details.
Aegis blue and navy relationship graph on a light canvas, with matching controls and record details.
Read-only metadata inspection preserves Dashboard chat and processing workflows; no model calls, graph database or schema changes are required.

releases.title: Dataset knowledge, within easy reach
changes: Add Dataset Knowledge stays visible in a sticky toolbar while sources and chat scroll, including when Sources is collapsed.
Combine multiple datasets using the Include dataset checkboxes or the indexed-file picker.
Drag dataset cards into Sources to include their accessible indexed files, preserving other selected sources.
Find the current version and version-by-version feature history on the About screen.

releases.title: Aegis baseline and Dashboard foundation
changes: Document onboarding, uploads, model mappings, extraction, review and the original Aegis Agent.
Dashboard with dataset cards, permitted Unified Knowledge sources and a separate read-only Dataset Knowledge Chat.
Chat opens on demand. Greetings and self-contained general questions use the selected model without knowledge lookup; dataset questions retain retrieval, reranking and citations.
Compact Connections footer with model hosting details. Original Dataset onboarding remains in its existing workspace.
